risk_description:
Due to an error in the assembly process, the wire harness may be pinched between the pillion step and the frame body or between the luggage box and the frame body. 
As a result, disconnection and short circuit of the wire harness may occur, causing the engine to stall while riding and increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not meet the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the type-approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
